snippet.title: My Silly Science Summer in the Past
snippet.description:
The new visual novel from TLS. (In English and German)
How have you ended up in 1992? At a science camp? Well, you've got to do the best of it... maybe find friends... and solve the mystery!
Get it for free on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645710/My_Silly_Science_Summer_in_the_Past/
or on itch.io (with web version): https://thelastsecret.itch.io/silly-science-summer
